title: Identification of PANoptosis hub genes driving immune activation and tubulointerstitial injury in diabetic kidney disease by integrative bioinformatics and machine learning.
authors: Chen, Yintong; Yuan, Feifei; Li, Shengyuan; Liu, Lerong; Peng, Xuankun; Zeng, Xiangrong; Chen, Siyong; Liu, Nianping; Zhao, Tongfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文用生物信息学与机器学习识别糖尿病肾病中PANoptosis枢纽基因，虽涉及转录因子调控网络推断，但核心是疾病基因表达与免疫浸润，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is characterized by chronic inflammation and immune dysregulation. Multiple programmed cell death pathways contribute to tubulointerstitial injury, but their perturbations, crosstalk, and integrative impact in DKD remain unclear. PANoptosis-a coordinated program integrating pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis-has emerged as a key mechanism in inflammatory disorders, yet its role in DKD is not defined. METHODS: We integrated multiple renal tubulointerstitial transcriptomic datasets from DKD and control cohorts to identify differentially expressed genes, followed by functional enrichment analysis. PANoptosis-related gene sets were curated from MSigDB, and pathway crosstalk was evaluated using independent single-cell RNA-seq datasets. Hub genes were prioritized by combining weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) with five machine-learning algorithms, and a PANoptosis-related risk score (PRS) was constructed and correlated with clinical parameters and immune infiltration. miRNA-mRNA and transcription factor-hub gene regulatory networks were inferred using ENCORI and hTFtarget, respectively. Druggability of hub genes was assessed using DrugnomeAI, and candidate compounds were retrieved from DGIdb. Key findings were validated in diabetic mouse models. RESULTS: Apoptosis, pyroptosis, necroptosis and the integrated PANoptosis program were markedly activated in DKD. At the single-cell level, these pathways were frequently co-activated within tubular and interstitial cell types, with extensive molecular overlap. Six PANoptosis-related hub genes (YWHAH, PRKACB, PSMB9, FAS, GZMA, CASP1) were identified; their expression correlated negatively with glomerular filtration rate and positively with serum creatinine and immune-cell infiltration. The PRS robustly discriminated DKD from controls and identified a high-risk subgroup with heightened immune infiltration and impaired renal function. Regulatory network analysis revealed convergent miRNA and transcription factor control of key hub genes. Druggability profiling with DrugnomeAI highlighted CASP1, FAS, PSMB9 and PRKACB as experimentally tractable and pharmacologically actionable targets, and DGIdb suggested multiple repurposable agents against these nodes. CONCLUSION: This study delineates extensive perturbations and crosstalk among apoptosis, pyroptosis and necroptosis in DKD, positioning PANoptosis as a unifying driver of tubulointerstitial injury. The six PANoptosis hub genes and their derived PRS show strong diagnostic potential, while integrated regulatory and druggability analyses nominate CASP1, FAS, PSMB9 and PRKACB as promising biomarkers and therapeutic entry points for PANoptosis-centered interventions in DKD.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病肾病（DKD）以慢性炎症和免疫失调为特征。多种程序性细胞死亡途径参与肾小管间质损伤，但其在DKD中的扰动、交互作用及整体影响仍不清楚。PANoptosis——一种整合焦亡、凋亡和坏死性凋亡的协调程序——已成为炎症性疾病中的关键机制，但其在DKD中的作用尚未明确。方法：我们整合了来自DKD和对照队列的多个肾小管间质转录组数据集，以识别差异表达基因，随后进行功能富集分析。PANoptosis相关基因集从MSigDB中整理，并使用独立的单细胞RNA-seq数据集评估通路交互。通过结合加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）与五种机器学习算法优先排序枢纽基因，构建了PANoptosis相关风险评分（PRS），并将其与临床参数和免疫浸润相关联。分别使用ENCORI和hTFtarget推断miRNA-mRNA和转录因子-枢纽基因调控网络。使用DrugnomeAI评估枢纽基因的可成药性，并从DGIdb检索候选化合物。关键发现在糖尿病小鼠模型中得到验证。结果：凋亡、焦亡、坏死性凋亡及整合的PANoptosis程序在DKD中显著激活。在单细胞水平上，这些通路在肾小管和间质细胞类型中频繁共激活，并存在广泛的分子重叠。识别出六个PANoptosis相关枢纽基因（YWHAH、PRKACB、PSMB9、FAS、GZMA、CASP1）；其表达与肾小球滤过率呈负相关，与血清肌酐和免疫细胞浸润呈正相关。PRS能稳健地区分DKD与对照组，并识别出免疫浸润增强和肾功能受损的高风险亚组。调控网络分析揭示了关键枢纽基因的趋同miRNA和转录因子控制。使用DrugnomeAI进行的可成药性分析突出显示CASP1、FAS、PSMB9和PRKACB为实验上可操作且药理学上可靶向的靶点，DGIdb则提示多种可重定位药物针对这些节点。结论：本研究描绘了DKD中凋亡、焦亡和坏死性凋亡之间的广泛扰动和交互，将PANoptosis定位为肾小管间质损伤的统一驱动因素。六个PANoptosis枢纽基因及其衍生的PRS显示出强大的诊断潜力，而整合的调控和可成药性分析提名CASP1、FAS、PSMB9和PRKACB作为DKD中PANoptosis中心干预的有前景的生物标志物和治疗切入点。
